source_title: 렙업 구간에 힐러가 없는게 이해가 되네 ㅋㅋㅋ
subtitle: 렙업 인던 힐러가 멸종한 완벽한 순환 논리

cuts.speaker: 스카이본 마법사
cuts.dialogue:
렙업 인던 40분째 대기 중…
힐러님 한 분만 제발요!!
cuts.visual_prompt: Low-angle desperate plea shot in cute 2.5-head chibi SD style on a pure #FFFFFF background with minimal cobblestone ground touch. On the left, weeping Skyborne Mage (sky-blue high side-ponytail, tilted blue wizard hat with smiling cloud-wing badge, cloud capelet, single blue crystal staff stowed on back) drops kneeling on the stones clasping both empty hands pleadingly with streaming comic tears. On the right, calm Tauren Druid (brown plush cow hood with ivory horns and gold nose ring, leafy-green shoulder mantle, single leafy wooden staff stowed on back) crosses her arms squinting thoughtfully in sudden enlightenment.

cuts.speaker: 타우렌 드루이드
cuts.dialogue:
힐러로 가면 딜템 못 먹지?
인던 안 가면 힐템 필요 없지
cuts.visual_prompt: Over-the-shoulder shot from behind kneeling Skyborne Mage (tilted blue wizard hat with smiling cloud-wing badge in left foreground, single blue crystal staff stowed on back) looking up at enlightened Tauren Druid on the right, in cute 2.5-head chibi SD style on a pure #FFFFFF background. On the right, Tauren Druid (brown plush cow hood with ivory horns, single leafy wooden staff stowed on back) raises one finger smugly like a sage with a bright glowing lightbulb sparkle above her horns (zero text or letters).

cuts.speaker: 타우렌 드루이드
cuts.dialogue:
걍 퀘로 딜템 먹고 만렙 찍지
렙업 때 누가 힐러 함ㅋㅋ
cuts.visual_prompt: Side-profile comedic realization shot in cute 2.5-head chibi SD style on a pure #FFFFFF background with minimal grassy trail touch. On the left, smug enlightened Tauren Druid (single leafy wooden staff stowed on back) spreads both empty hands wide grinning triumphantly as tiny swirling green nature leaves drift around her. On the right, Troll Shaman (sky-blue plush troll hood with red mohawk and tiny tusks, mint bob, single wooden totem staff stowed on back) widens her emerald eyes clapping her fists together in starry-eyed epiphany.

Centered Dutch-tilt extreme big bust-up close-up filling 80 percent of frame height in cute 2.5-head chibi SD style on a pure #FFFFFF background. Skyborne Mage (sky-blue high side-ponytail, tilted blue wizard hat with smiling cloud-wing badge, cloud capelet) freezes completely petrified in pale blue shock with tiny blank lifeless dot eyes, trembling parted mouth, and jagged vertical despair lines behind her head because the math is undeniable (zero text, letters, or speech bubbles).

cuts.speaker: 트롤 주술사
cuts.dialogue:
와 반박 불가네 ㄷㄷ
저도 바로 정술로 퀘 밀러 감!
cuts.visual_prompt: High-angle comedic departure shot in cute 2.5-head chibi SD style on a pure #FFFFFF background with minimal dirt path touch. On the left, fired-up Troll Shaman (sky-blue plush troll hood with red mohawk, mint bob) raises her single wooden totem staff crackling with bright blue Elemental lightning sparks while flashing an enthusiastic thumbs-up with her other hand grinning widely. On the right, stunned Skyborne Mage (single blue crystal staff stowed on back) reaches out weakly with trembling empty hands trying in vain to stop her.

cuts.speaker: 스카이본 마법사
cuts.dialogue:
반박할 말이 하나도 없네…
인던 접고 나도 퀘나 밀자
cuts.visual_prompt: Back-view three-quarter wide comic finale in cute 2.5-head chibi SD style on a pure #FFFFFF background with minimal dirt road touch. On the left, utterly defeated Skyborne Mage (sky-blue high side-ponytail, blue wizard hat drooping, single blue crystal staff resting on the ground beside her) sits slumped cross-legged hugging her knees under a tiny gloomy rain puff. On the right, cheerful Tauren Druid (single leafy wooden staff stowed on back) walks happily away down the trail waving goodbye over her shoulder to go solo-questing.
